items.originalTitle: Extreme Environments Push Chips To Their Breaking Point
items.summary: Orbital data centers, military/aerospace vehicles, HPC experiments, quantum, and advanced manufacturing equipment are all putting pressure on chips to withstand extreme environments. Chips that were once qualified against a limited set of operating conditions are now being designed for environments where multiple stresses hit at once. Radiation, thermal shock, vibration, pressure, noise, and cryogenic temperatures are colliding in applications ranging from orbital data centers and defense systems to particle physics, quantum computing, and advanced manufacturing.

Editing the text also makes the watermark harder to detect.
OpenAI says replacing just 10 percent of words with synonyms cuts detection rates for 400-token passages from about 92 percent to 66 percent.
Replacing a quarter of the words drops detection to 17 percent, making the watermark easy to evade.
That weakness could work in OpenAI's favor.
OpenAI also says a detected watermark reveals nothing about how much human creativity or editing went into the text.

displayTranslation.summary: OpenAI正在为ChatGPT文本添加不可见水印，以遵守欧盟规定。与Anthropic不同，它将允许全球API客户关闭该功能。据报道，欧盟《人工智能法案》要求AI提供商以机器可读格式标注生成的文本。OpenAI的解决方案是textGrain，该技术通过模型选词嵌入不可见的统计信号，其原理与Claude使用谷歌开源技术的SynthID水印类似。OpenAI表示，将在未来几周内为欧盟的ChatGPT和Codex用户开启水印功能。
displayTranslation.sourceTitle: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT text in the EU but makes it optional for API users worldwide
displayTranslation.sourceSummary: OpenAI is adding invisible watermarks to ChatGPT text to comply with EU rules. Unlike Anthropic, it will let API customers worldwide turn them off. The EU AI Act reportedly requires AI providers to label generated text in a machine-readable format. OpenAI's answer is textGrain, a technology that embeds an invisible statistical signal in the model's word choices. It works much like Claude's SynthID watermark, which uses Google's open-source technology. OpenAI says it will turn on watermarking for ChatGPT and Codex users in the European Union over the coming weeks.

chapters.title: First Release Of USAF’s New HACM Hypersonic Cruise Missile Has Happened Over Australian Range
chapters.angle: 追踪本次报道中的具体变化

blocks.text: Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) has finally reached the flight test phase, with at least one “release” having been carried out so far over a range in Australia.

displayTranslation.text: 美国空军采用超燃冲压发动机的“高超音速攻击巡航导弹”（HACM）终于进入飞行测试阶段，目前已在澳大利亚的一处靶场上进行了至少一次“释放”。
displayTranslation.sourceText: Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) has finally reached the flight test phase, with at least one “release” having been carried out so far over a range in Australia.

blocks.text: DARPA “The U.S. Air Force, in partnership with Australia, has conducted a flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) as part of our continuous work to advance long-range strike capabilities,” an Air Force spokesperson confirmed to TWZ today.

displayTranslation.text: 一位美国空军发言人今天向TWZ证实：“美国空军与澳大利亚合作，进行了高超音速攻击巡航导弹（HACM）的飞行测试，这是我们持续推进远程打击能力工作的一部分。”
displayTranslation.sourceText: DARPA “The U.S. Air Force, in partnership with Australia, has conducted a flight test of the Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM) as part of our continuous work to advance long-range strike capabilities,” an Air Force spokesperson confirmed to TWZ today.

blocks.text: “This effort is part of the Southern Cross Integrated Flight Research Experiment (SCIFiRE), a collaborative agreement built on more than 15 years of partnership between our two nations.” “Leveraging this enduring alliance, the Royal Australian Air Force executed the release of a HACM flight test unit over a designated Australian test range, gathering crucial data to advance the program’s objectives,” the spokesperson added.

displayTranslation.text: 这位发言人补充说：“这项工作属于‘南十字星综合飞行研究实验’（SCIFiRE）的一部分，该合作协议建立在我们两国超过15年伙伴关系的基础之上。”“依托这一持久联盟，澳大利亚皇家空军在指定的澳大利亚试验靶场上执行了HACM飞行测试单元的释放，收集了推进该项目目标的关键数据。”

blocks.text: Blackbeard, an air-launched, long-range hypersonic strike missile, successfully completed another milestone recently, with a flight test on an F/A-18E/F Super Hornet at Naval Air Station (NAS) Patuxent River, Maryland.
